link_power_management_states.name: Active
link_power_management_states.description: Normal CXL operation; CXL.io + CXL.cache + CXL.mem flow.

link_power_management_states.name: Link standby
link_power_management_states.description: Inherited PCIe L1; ARB/MUX manages per-sub-protocol virtual LSM PM entry/exit.

link_power_management_states.name: Deep sleep
link_power_management_states.description: Inherited PCIe L2; REFCLK may stop; wake re-trains the Flex Bus.

low_power_modes_summary.L1_standby: Link standby; ARB/MUX coordinates PM across CXL.io and CXL.cache/CXL.mem virtual LSMs.
low_power_modes_summary.L2_sleep: Deep sleep over the PCIe Flex Bus.

device_power_states.description: Main power removed; aux power only.

fields.notes: CXL link power management builds on PCIe PM (L0/L1/L2). The ARB/MUX block maintains a virtual link-state-machine per sub-protocol so that CXL.io and the CXL.cache/CXL.mem stack can coordinate PM-state entry and exit over the shared Flex Bus.

extraction_hints: Look for power-domain partitioning, supply nets.
